item.title: CVE-2026-78674 — BPMN System REST APIs access control bypass
item.description:
CVE ID :CVE-2026-78674
Published : Mercoledì 28 Ottobre 2026 19:21 | 28 minuti ago
Description :The BPMN System REST APIs allow an attacker to bypass access controls. An authenticated user can leverage this flaw to read arbitrary data. -- Visit the link for more details about this vulnerability.
